{{Quote|What ''is'' it, Luke&mdash;? You look like you've been through a Razian psycho-storm&mdash;!|Han Solo|<ref name="As Long As We Live...">"[[As Long As We Live...]]"</ref>}}
A '''Razian psycho-storm''' was a phenomenon that originated in the [[Razia system/Legends|Razia system]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], having learned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]] of the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and having experienced a betrayal by the local [[Kiros Zorad]], met his friend, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the latter commented that Skywalker looked as if he had been subjected to a Razian psycho-storm.

==Description==
A Razian psycho-storm was a type of phenomenon<ref name="As Long As We Live..." /> originating in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Razian psycho-storm|system=[[Razia system/Legends|Razia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Razia system/Legends|Razia system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It could negatively affect the behavior of beings subjected to it.<ref name="As Long As We Live..." />

==History==
[[File:RazianPsychoStorm-AsLongAsWeLive.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Han Solo compared Luke Skywalker's look to him having experienced a Razian psycho-storm.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] accompanied the Rebel leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]]. During their visit, when Skywalker and the local [[Kiros Zorad]] came to believe that both the latter's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Zon Zorad|Zon]], and a kidnapped Organa had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Caverns of Colla-Di]] by one of the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[kdak]] creatures, Kiros wanted to exact vengeance upon [[Mag Doum]], who had originally tasked him with interfering with Organa's mission.<ref name="As Long As We Live..." />

Despite the fact that Skywalker had just saved his life from a kdak, Kiros believed that Skywalker would attempt to stop him in his revenge attempt, leading the local to steal the Rebel's [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and knock him out, subsequently driving Skywalker's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] away from the [[Cave/Legends|caverns]]. When Skywalker later regained consciousness, he realized what had happened and then, to his relief, encountered his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had also arrived on Arda II. Upon seeing Skywalker, Solo remarked that the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] looked as though he had suffered a Razian psycho-storm, at which point the Rebel relayed to his friend his experiences on the planet.<ref name="As Long As We Live..." />

==Behind the scenes==
The Razian psycho-storm was mentioned in "[[As Long As We Live...]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Don Christensen]], penciled by [[Russ Manning]], and published<ref name="As Long As We Live..." /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref>
